scope: ID-disjoint availability-purged completed trials from the unchanged authentic duration cohort, never used in fitting, tuning, calibration or original test. Stress audit, not a temporal/pretrial/future test. Selection of these rows explicitly depends on outcome availability and creates a different outcome distribution.
endpoint: Same original training-derived threshold1105days; no threshold refit.
selection: Candidate chooses by original tuning raw Brier, then AUROC, then declared order; include existing raw multimodal comparator. Threshold0.5 fixed for reported classification; no audit tuning, row trimming or class regrouping.
limitations: Outcome-dependent subgroup distribution; not evidence that accuracy transports to ordinary unseen trials. Previous test scores remain historical, never reused as an untouched tuning target.
